# ashmo.io

> Independent educational website by Ashraf Hassan (Ashmo), a brand builder and writer.

## Scope
General professional guidance on customers, brand positioning, marketing, pricing and restaurant growth. Market notes use public sources. Hypothetical examples are labelled. The website does not represent an employer, client or partner and does not imply their endorsement.
